required_live_sources: product request, site-visit, and quote-ready records
attributed quote and won-work records from an operator-approved integration or manual reconciliation
Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools after ownership is verified
crawler and server logs that exclude secrets and private content

allowed_scope: frontend public marketing pages through a reviewable product source change
definition_of_done: All used metrics cite retained source evidence and an observation window.
The diagnosis separates crawl, indexing, relevance, click, conversion, and commercial-value problems.
The proposed experiment states its customer hypothesis, target page, change, primary conversion metric, guardrails, and review date.
A new page is proposed only for a distinct unmet intent with evidence; otherwise improve or retire existing content.
The output is reviewable and is not automatically published.
forbidden_scope: fabricated backlinks, reviews, citations, mentions, customers, revenue, or outcomes
private customer data or authenticated content
task.objective: Use retained search, analytics, crawl, AI-referral, conversion, and commercial evidence to propose the smallest high-confidence organic growth experiment.
task.title: Learn from QuoteRivet organic discovery evidence
